decks.notes: The main strategy of this deck is to quickly assemble The Fantasticar combo, which allows you to generate a large amount of mana and card advantage. By using cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal, you can power out The Fantasticar early in the game. Other cards in the deck, such as Quantum Riddler and Flow State, help to filter your draws and protect your combo. By disrupting your opponent with cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will, you can ensure that you have enough time to set up and execute the combo for a game-winning play.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing lands to disrupt the opponent's strategy. It aims to lock down the opponent's resources with cards like Sphere of Resistance and Wasteland while also generating value through cards like Urza's Saga and Life from the Loam. The deck also has a combo finish with Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to quickly close out the game. Overall, this deck relies on efficient land management and disruption to outgrind the opponent and secure victory.

This deck focuses on quickly developing board presence and disrupting the opponent's game plan through aggressive tempo plays. By utilizing a combination of efficient removal spells, card draw, and disruptive creatures like Murktide Regent and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares, the deck aims to control the game's pace and apply pressure on the opponent. With a mix of countermagic and hand disruption, the deck can disrupt the opponent's strategy while advancing its own game plan of aggression and tempo advantage. The mana base is crafted to support the deck's color requirements for its spells and maximize its efficiency.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while quickly establishing a threatening board presence. By using cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's strategy, combined with aggressive creatures like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to apply pressure and control the game tempo. Additionally, cards like Daze and Fatal Push help in maintaining board control and handling threats efficiently. With a mix of disruption, aggression, and card advantage, the deck looks to outpace and outmaneuver its opponents to secure a swift victory.

This deck focuses on using Cloudpost / Tron ramp strategies to quickly generate mana and play big threats like Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, Eye of the Storms. It also includes a variety of control elements such as Force of Will and Force of Negation to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to control the game early on with counterspells and removal, before eventually overwhelming the opponent with powerful late-game threats and card advantage from cards like Thundertrap Trainer and Waterlogged Teachings.

This Dimir Tempo deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal while putting pressure on them with efficient creatures like Barrowgoyf and Nethergoyf. The deck also includes a strong mana denial package with cards like Wasteland and Undercity Sewers to slow down the opponent. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage and control elements, while cards like Brazen Borrower and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares offer versatility and additional disruption. The deck aims to maintain a tempo advantage by controlling the game while quickly closing out with its creatures.

The main concept of this deck is to use spells like Tibalt's Trickery, Violent Outburst, and Throes of Chaos to quickly and efficiently cascade through the deck to find powerful cards like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Apex Devastator. With cards like Creative Technique and Call Forth the Tempest, the deck can manipulate the randomness of cascade to its advantage. The mana base includes lands that provide extra mana to cast large spells like Emrakul, as well as lands that produce multiple colors to ensure the deck can cast its various spells.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive abilities to prevent the opponent from executing their game plan. It also incorporates the combo of Dress Down and Phyrexian Dreadnought to quickly put pressure on the opponent. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage and Curie, Emergent Intelligence helps filter through the deck. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt and control the game while setting up powerful plays to secure a victory.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while maintaining pressure with efficient creatures and removal spells. By combining disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will with aggressive threats like Nethergoyf and Moonshadow, the deck aims to control the game tempo and outpace the opponent. The mana base is designed to support the deck's two-color identity while also including utility lands like Wasteland and Undercity Sewers. Overall, the deck aims to quickly close out games by disrupting the opponent's plans and applying pressure with efficient threats.

The main concept of this Legacy 1 vs 1 deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with cards like Stitcher's Supplier and Once Upon a Time in order to bring out powerful creatures like Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis. The deck includes ways to protect key cards like Sylvan Safekeeper and Bojuka Bog, while also disrupting the opponent with cards like Thoughtseize and Wasteland. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a strong board presence and utilize the graveyard as a resource for powerful combos and plays.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's mana base with cards like Trinisphere and Blood Moon while quickly deploying threats like Pyrogoyf and Magus of the Moon. By utilizing fast mana sources like Lotus Petal and Elvish Spirit Guide, the deck aims to establish board presence early and seize control of the game. The mix of aggressive creatures and disruptive elements allows the deck to apply pressure while limiting the opponent's options, ultimately aiming to win the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The main strategy of this deck is to quickly cheat out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn using cards like Show and Tell and Sneak Attack. The deck includes ways to generate mana quickly with cards like Lotus Petal and Simian Spirit Guide, as well as protect your combo pieces with counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce. A key card in this deck is Omniscience, allowing you to cast spells for free once it's on the battlefield. The goal is to overwhelm your opponent with massive threats early in the game.

The deck focuses on quick and efficient plays, utilizing tempo control and disruption to maintain board advantage while applying pressure to the opponent. It combines aggressive creatures like Tarmogoyf and Murktide Regent with control elements like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes card draw and selection tools like Brainstorm and Ponder to ensure consistency in draws. Wasteland and Daze provide additional disruption, while Fatal Push and Snuff Out help deal with threats from the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent to secure victory.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the combo of Doomsday and Thassa's Oracle to win the game. It includes a mix of control elements like Force of Will and Teferi, Time Raveler to protect the combo and disrupt opponents. The deck also utilizes powerful draw and search spells like Ponder and Brainstorm to find the combo pieces efficiently. Additionally, it includes cards like Veil of Summer for protection and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student for additional card advantage. The deck aims to win the game by executing the Doomsday combo as quickly and efficiently as possible.

The main concept of this UWx Control deck is to disrupt your opponent's game plan using cards like Daze, Stifle, and Force of Will while also generating card advantage through cards like Quantum Riddler and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The deck focuses on controlling the board with removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and countering key spells with Force of Will. The win condition comes from playing powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd. Additionally, the deck runs a mana denial strategy with Wasteland to slow down the opponent's mana development.

This deck revolves around utilizing Goblin Engineer and Goblin Welder to manipulate artifacts like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mishra's Bauble, while also leveraging cards like Urza's Saga and Mox Opal to generate mana and card advantage. The inclusion of Pinnacle Emissary and Loki, God of Mischief allows for alternate win conditions through combat or stealing opponents' cards. Additionally, cards like Sewer-veillance Cam and The Filigree Sylex provide additional utility and disruption. The deck aims to assemble powerful artifact synergies and combo off to overwhelm opponents.
